relationships.subject: migraine frequency
relationships.evidence_quote: Mean CSF but not plasma soluble vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (sVCAM-1) levels were significantly higher in those with more frequent migraine

relationships.subject: migraine
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to controls, the migraine group had significantly higher mean CSF-blood quotients of albumin

key_findings: Migraine showed higher CSF-blood quotients of albumin and fibrinogen, suggesting altered transport at the choroid plexus blood-CSF barrier rather than endothelial disruption.
CSF sVCAM1 rose with migraine frequency, while MMP-9 and inflammatory cytokines did not differ from controls.
